factual_claims.claim: Key developments included the completion of LHV Pank’s migration to a cloud-based core system, a new product-based management model, Estonia’s first bank crypto-assets licence under MiCA, and continued preparations for international expansion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The most important technological event of the quarter was the successful transition of the Bank’s core systems to the Amazon Web Services cloud environment ... The Bank transitioned to a product-based management model in Q2 ... The Financial Supervision and Resolution Authority issued LHV Pank a crypto-assets service provider license under the MiCA Regulation in Q2 ... Preparations were also launched for the cross-border registration of a credit institution’s license in the European Economic Area.

factual_claims.claim: The operating environment remained affected by geopolitical tensions, energy-market uncertainty and volatile financial markets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

The Middle East conflict showed the first signs of de-escalation in mid-June ... Financial markets were volatile during the quarter, a reflection of the Middle East conflict and growing expectations of the profitability of investments into artificial intelligence.
